```
The streamer read only input/output tokens and cache fields, so a streamed Claude
response lost output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens that the non-streaming
into_usage() maps to completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens. Move the snapshot
merge into merge_usage_snapshot() and capture the thinking share the same way.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
